system.description: The psychic compresses a field of energy at a point on or near the target’s body and explodes it, like coiling a spring and suddenly releasing it. The damage is equal to Wits+victory points. This is stun damage, like from a Stunner Gun, and ignores energy shields. If the target takes ANY damage (after figuring armor points), he must roll Endurance+Vigor. A failure means he is stunned that turn and the next; on a critical failure, he falls unconscious. If the damage taken is greater than the target’s Endurance, a failure means the target is knocked unconscious. Stun damage heals completely…
